filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Mon Nov 9 (after the 8:55 AM run) – Tue Nov 10 morning PT (items already on the Nov 9 brief not re-led)

market_briefing.lede: Enterprise agent buying is moving onto existing admin and procurement rails: Gong's November release adds agent and skill templates, MCP read/write connections, and an hourly API/MCP usage report, while OpenAI now sells ChatGPT Enterprise — including Codex and dots — through AWS Marketplace against existing cloud commitments.

bullets.text: Nov 10: Gong's November release (rolling out through the month) adds ready-made agent and skill templates for revenue workflows, MCP connections that let Gong Assistant and agents read and update Salesforce, Jira, and Zendesk, Enrich as an agent action plus Apollo (bring-your-own key) and Firmable as data partners, Gong Assistant in account/deal/call panels replacing Ask Anything, and an hourly API/MCP usage report by endpoint, integration, and user.

Nov 9: ChatGPT Enterprise (ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, Codex, dots) is listed on AWS Marketplace; eligible spend can count toward AWS commitments, pricing is by private offer, and ChatGPT for Healthcare / Financial Services are also available there.

Nov 9: Anthropic opened a private beta of Enterprise Frontier Safeguards — safety monitoring that runs on prompts and responses stored in the customer's own infrastructure, compatible with zero data retention — naming Bridgewater, Salesforce, and Stripe; non-ZDR customers get 30-day retention for Fable/Mythos 5.2 monitoring.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic ships Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 9: same underlying model (Fable broadly available; Mythos limited to vetted cyber and life-sciences orgs), up to 30% faster output, price cut to $8/$40 per M input/output tokens (from $10/$50 per InfoWorld), optional fast mode; Anthropic says Fable 5.2 at High effort matches Opus 5.5's best FrontierCode score at about half the cost per task.

biggest_ai_news.title: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon generally available
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 10: Google's strongest model for long-horizon agentic work and cyber, on the Gemini API and Gemini for business at an introductory $2/$10 per M tokens (rising to $4/$20 after Nov 30), plus a /swarm multi-agent preview in Antigravity.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow at $70–$78 a share
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 10: 825M Class A shares (801.4M from Anthropic), Nasdaq ticker "ANT"; Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley on the prospectus.

biggest_ai_news.title: Meta releases Muse Ember for high-volume agent execution
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 9: Meta's smallest Muse model, built for tool calls, routing, extraction, and document parsing, at $0.10 per M input tokens; positioned as the executor paired with Muse Wonder for planning.

what_changed.title: Gong November release: agent templates, MCP write-back, Apollo/Firmable Enrich, API/MCP usage report
what_changed.body: Nov 10 Gong help-center monthly update (features rolling out through November): agent and skill templates; MCP connections to read and update Salesforce, Jira, Zendesk (and Highspot context) from Gong Assistant and agents; Enrich as an agent action plus Apollo (BYO API key) and Firmable providers; Gong Assistant replaces Ask Anything in account/deal/call panels; an hourly API/MCP usage report; Salesforce ETM territory and opportunity-product imports for forecasting; Gong Engage flows generated from a prompt. No pricing change stated.

what_changed.title: OpenAI puts ChatGPT Enterprise on AWS Marketplace
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Nov 9: AWS customers can buy ChatGPT Enterprise (incl. Codex and dots) through existing AWS billing and apply eligible spend to AWS commitments; same features as buying direct; Sophos quoted. Complements OpenAI models in Amazon Bedrock.

what_changed.title: Anthropic releases Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2 and Enterprise Frontier Safeguards beta
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Nov 9: lower price ($8/$40 per M tokens), up to 30% faster, ~55% fewer safeguard blocks than Fable 5.1; Enterprise Frontier Safeguards private beta (Bridgewater, Salesforce, Stripe) runs misuse monitoring on customer-stored data; Claude Security now uses Mythos 5.2 and exposes an API/MCP. Nov 10: IPO roadshow launched at $70–$78/share.

what_changed.title: Google ships Gemini 4 Carbon with Antigravity /swarm
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Nov 10: Carbon available to paying API and Gemini for business customers at Argon's introductory price; Google cites #1 on Zapier's AutomationBench and CursorBench 4.0 at more than 2× lower cost per task than the next external model.

what_changed.title: OpenAI's "Tomorrow." tease resolves to Codex-edition hardware; Control Room and multi-machine dots also ship
what_changed.body: Nov 9: @OpenAIDevs' Nov 8 tease was the Codex-edition ModRetro Chromatic handheld on OpenAI's Supply Co (merch plus a Codex plugin) — not a model or API launch. Same day: dots can now connect to multiple local computers and pick which one runs a task, and OpenAI published Control Room, which halts research inference within 35 seconds and fails closed.

quiet_note: No new launch/funding/M&A/pricing from Salesforce, Clay, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft, or Monaco dated Nov 9–10. Salesforce's Nov 10 Indonesia and Korea Coworker releases are regional reissues of the Nov 4 story (185k users, $50/user/mo; Teams/iOS/Mac/Windows + MCP server GA in November; Scheduled Tasks and Daily Digest in December). Salesloft newsroom still tops out at the Oct 27 Agentic Playbook early-access post. Clay's pricing-page AI token pricing (flagged by a page-change tracker Nov 8–9) dates to March 2026. Outreach's Snowflake data share (Nov 3) and Salesforce's Agentforce Memory recall post (Nov 3) are older and stay on competitor pages.

market_direction.label: Accelerating (agent admin and metering inside revenue platforms)
market_direction.text: Gong's November release pairs agent templates and MCP write-back with an hourly API/MCP usage report and credit-scoped trackers — the same control-and-cost framing as its Nov 9 Agent Builder post.

market_direction.label: Accelerating (AI bought through cloud procurement)
market_direction.text: ChatGPT Enterprise on AWS Marketplace (Nov 9) lets buyers spend committed cloud budget on seat-based AI, alongside Claude and Gemini on the hyperscaler marketplaces.

market_direction.label: New (customer-side safety monitoring)
market_direction.text: Anthropic's Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (Nov 9) moves misuse monitoring into the customer's infrastructure to fit zero data retention; OpenAI's Control Room (Nov 9) shows the lab-side version of stopping agent workloads fast.

market_direction.label: Steady (rest of watchlist)
market_direction.text: Salesforce, Clay, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft, Monaco quiet Nov 9–10; Salesloft Agentic Playbook still early access.

competitive_moves.text: November release (Nov 10): agent/skill templates, MCP read/write into Salesforce/Jira/Zendesk, Enrich as an agent action with Apollo and Firmable added, Gong Assistant replacing Ask Anything in account/deal/call panels, hourly API/MCP usage report, Salesforce territory (ETM) and opportunity-product imports for Forecast.

watch.title: Anthropic IPO pricing; Agentforce Coworker November GA items; Agent Evals beta start; Salesloft Agentic Playbook GA/pricing
watch.body: Anthropic's roadshow (Nov 10) sets a $70–$78 range for "ANT"; pricing date not stated in the release. Salesforce still lists Coworker in Teams, iOS/Mac/Windows apps, and the Coworker MCP server as GA in November and Agent Evals / API Evals as beta in November, with no start notice yet. Salesloft newsroom is still on the Oct 27 early-access post.

interpretation.fact: Nov 10 Gong published its November release (agent/skill templates, MCP connections that update Salesforce/Jira/Zendesk, Apollo + Firmable Enrich, Assistant in account/deal/call panels, hourly API/MCP usage report). Nov 9 OpenAI listed ChatGPT Enterprise on AWS Marketplace, published Control Room, and shipped multi-machine dots; its "Tomorrow." tease was a Codex-edition handheld. Nov 9 Anthropic released Fable/Mythos 5.2 ($8/$40) and an Enterprise Frontier Safeguards private beta; Nov 10 it launched its IPO roadshow at $70–$78. Nov 10 Google made Gemini 4 Carbon available. Nov 9 Meta released Muse Ember ($0.10/M input). Salesloft newsroom still Oct 27. No other watchlist launch/funding/M&A/pricing Nov 9–10.
interpretation.note: Revenue platforms are competing on how agents are administered, not just what they do: Gong now ships templates, write-back through MCP, and metering in the same release, the pattern Salesforce set with Agent Fabric spend controls. At the same time the labs are making agent seats easier to buy (cloud marketplaces) and cheaper per task (Fable 5.2, Carbon, Ember), which lowers the bar for horizontal tools to cover revenue workflows.
